notes: 'with' of 'filled with contempt' goes to שָׂבַעְנוּ: בוּז is the bare complement the stative verb governs, and 'filled with' admits no other English preposition, so the word answers to the predicate's valency (rules 33/44) and the noun keeps only 'contempt'.
רַב → 'exceedingly' is the adverbial accusative rendered by its own word; the verb's unit is discontinuous around it under rule 25.
